name: Onchain Yield Coin
oneLiner: ONYC is a Solana-based NAV-accreting yield token backed by OnRe-managed structured insurance and reinsurance positions; not a hard $1 peg.
collateral: Tokenized exposure to OnRe-managed structured insurance and reinsurance yield products, designed to hold stable value while distributing real-world insurance-market returns through NAV appreciation
pegMechanism: ONYC is a yield-bearing stable-value token rather than a fixed $1 wrapper; the token value accrues yield from OnRe's structured insurance collateral strategies, with primary-market access governed by OnRe's platform terms

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
reserveReview.rationale: OnRe's Transparency Hub fetched 2026-07-20 shows a $36.09M ONyc pool with $28.09M (77.83%) unallocated in the yielding asset reserve (~3.95% projected yield) and the remaining ~$8.0M (22.17%) deployed across five named short-duration specialty and ILW reinsurance deals. The table's per-deal 'Deal Value' figures are full deal capacities (they sum above the pool total), so the split is derived from the unallocated row against the stated total; that interpretation keeps confidence at probable. The FAQ confirms USDC and USDG as the pool's mint/stablecoin collateral and describes the unallocated reserve as supporting secondary liquidity and backstopping contracts. Apex Group performs monthly attestations (latest published covers NAV as of 2026-05-31), but the attestation PDF is view-restricted and could not be machine-read today. This replaces the prior single aggregate envelope with a two-slice full-composition record.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The split between USDC and USDG inside the unallocated collateral, per-deal deployed amounts, cedent identities, and claim reserves are not published; the May 2026 Apex attestation PDF is view-restricted.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The ONyc Pool operates inside a Bermuda segregated account whose assets and liabilities are legally ring-fenced from OnRe's other books, and On Re SAC Ltd holds BMA Class IIGB insurer and Class F DABA licences (registration 55347; registry match confirmed by the 2026-07-15 Pharos registry pass), which grounds segregated custody and a structured bankruptcy-remoteness posture. Not known: the off-chain banks, brokers, or reinsurance trust accounts holding posted collateral; per-account segregation at those institutions; and the recovery waterfall if a reinsurance counterparty or cedent defaults. Posting pool capital as collateral to reinsurance counterparties is the disclosed business model, recorded as conditional rehypothecation; no lending-out of the stablecoin reserve itself is documented. Collateral deployed into roughly 5-13 month reinsurance contracts is not withdrawable on demand, and primary redemptions remain subject to redemption windows, holding periods, and liquidity availability.

review.evidence: At Solana slot 432714278, ONYC mint authority remained PDA AbpE5YLpdpxj2jRczG9P341Jicf67NvZsaZYrATbMnNX under OnRe program onreuGhHHgVzMWSkj2oQDLDtvvGvoepBPkqyaubFcwe. It resolved to autonomous 3-of-6 Squads multisig 2AD4x72wXvjZVxSQPCt77NYZGXNdMbFvtD5F3mcUAtcN with zero timelock and no config authority. The Squads program itself was immutable. No permissionless mint route existed. Reserve reconciliation: OnRe appointed Apex Group as independent attestation provider for ONyc, with monthly attestations; the latest published product attestation covers ONyc NAV, treasury balances, and reserve allocations as of 2026-05-31. Prudential supervision: the Bermuda Monetary Authority registry identifies On Re SAC Ltd (registration number 55347) as both a Class IIGB insurer and a Class F digital-asset business, matching the ONyc issuing entity. Reviewed 2026-07-15.

Current OnRe documentation describes ONyc as a Solana token representing a proportional interest in a regulated Bermuda segregated account with NAV-based value, matching the tracked rwa-credit-fund mechanism. This dated launch is the determinable boundary for the current product implementation.
